LanguageData.Raven_Item_Cream.label: [Raven] Cream
LanguageData.Raven_Item_Cream.description: A rich cream made by mixing unfertilized Raven Spirit Eggs with fresh milk in a special ratio, followed by high-speed stirring and low-temperature fermentation. It emits a unique fragrance and is an essential ingredient for making high-end Raven desserts.
LanguageData.Raven_Food_CreamPuff.label: [Raven] Cream Puff
LanguageData.Raven_Food_CreamPuff.description: A crispy outer shell enveloping a generous amount of Raven cream. With one bite, the sweet cream bursts in the mouth, bringing unparalleled satisfaction. A delicious and exquisite meal.
LanguageData.Raven_Food_ExquisiteCake.label: [Raven] Exquisite Cake
LanguageData.Raven_Food_ExquisiteCake.description: A carefully baked small cake made with plenty of Raven cream and rare ingredients. It is beautifully decorated with a silky smooth texture. Tasting it is a luxurious enjoyment that greatly lifts one's mood.
